messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — I'm landing a refresh of the hello quickstart that switches examples to SDK v2 and consolidates auth docs. PR incoming -> #3124. Need review + a quick sanity check on the deploy snippet.
Sam: Thanks! can you paste the new env var name? I want to update the starter repo.
Ava: It's now REDWOOD_API_KEY (was REDWOOD_KEY). Short code:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxx
npm run start
```
Priya: Will the old env var still work? We have customers with scripts.
Ava: We're keeping a compatibility layer that reads REDWOOD_KEY for one month, but we should announce in migration guide. I'll add a note with timeline.
Jon: I'm updating the JS snippet — switching to fetch + streaming (also using the new auth var). Example:
```js
const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd/fast-1', prompt: 'hi' })
});
for await (const chunk of r.body) { process.stdout.write(chunk); }
```
Sam: Nice. Can we keep a tiny curl example for ops folks?
Ava: Yep — pushing both. Curl:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd/fast-1\",\"prompt\":\"hello\"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
Priya: Also suggest adding a note about region param default behavior — customers hitting latency in EU.
Ava: Good catch. Will add region best-practices and show explicit `?region=eu-west-1` example in the migration guide.
Sam: Do we need to bump the quickstart CI? Starter repo tests the example and currently expects old JSON shape.
Jon: I'll open patch in starter repo after this lands (will reference docs PR).
Ava: Timeline: I'll merge docs PR after 1-2 reviews, update /quickstart index and publish. Can y'all review today? @Sam @Jon
deploy-bot: deploy queued for docs-staging -> build 8243
Sam: Reviewing now. :eyes:
Jon: LGTM on code snippets, left one nit in wording around token accounting.
Priya: Quick nit: change "set env" -> "set an environment variable" in two places in the quickstart steps.
Ava: Thanks — fixing and will ping when merged.
Sam: Add a short migration blurb to CHANGELOG.md and send to #announcements when live.
Ava: Will do. :shipit:
